test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following pairs of newly created States/Union Territories after the States Reorganisation Act, 1956 is correctly matched?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chhattisgarh-2000**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The State of **Chhattisgarh was officially formed on November 1, 2000**, after being carved out of Madhya Pradesh.
 
• Chhattisgarh was created to address the cultural and administrative needs of the tribal population and other communities in the region.
 
• The creation of Chhattisgarh was part of a broader reorganization of states in India to ensure better governance and development.
 
• It became the 26th state of India, with **Raipur designated as its capital**.
 
• This reorganization followed the recommendations of the **State Reorganization Commission** and subsequent demands for separate statehood.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Jharkhand:**

 
 
• Jharkhand was carved out of Bihar on **November 15, 2000**.
 
• It is known for its rich mineral resources and dense forest cover.
 
• The capital city of Jharkhand is **Ranchi**.
 
 
 
• **Uttarakhand:**
 
 
• Uttarakhand, formerly known as Uttaranchal, was created on **November 9, 2000**.
 
• It was carved out of Uttar Pradesh to address the cultural and administrative needs of the hilly regions.
 
• The capital city is **Dehradun**.
 
 
 
• **Telangana:**
 
 
• Telangana was formed on **June 2, 2014**, as the 29th state of India.
 
• It was carved out of Andhra Pradesh following long-standing demands for statehood.
 
• The capital city of Telangana is **Hyderabad**.
 
 
 
• **State Reorganization Act, 1956:**
 
 
• This Act was a major reform in the political boundaries of India post-independence.
 
• It reorganized states and union territories primarily on the basis of linguistic and cultural lines.
 
• The Act led to the creation of several new states and redefined existing ones.
